items.prompt: Jutro ___ zakupy. (I'll get the shopping done tomorrow.)
items.explanation: One finished action in the future: the perfective form zrobię, no będę.
optionNotes: The perfective future needs no będę.
Będę goes only with an imperfective infinitive.
Byłem is the past and cannot go with an infinitive.
Zrobię is a verb of its own; it cannot help another verb.
Jestem + infinitive is not a future.

items.explanation: Kupić is perfective: its present-looking form kupię already means "I'll buy".
optionNotes: Two futures in one: drop będę.
Będę does not go with a perfective infinitive.
Będę is followed by an infinitive, not a present form.

items.prompt: Wieczorem ___ do kina. (I'll go to the cinema in the evening.)
items.explanation: The future of pójść keeps ó: pójdę.
optionNotes: Spelling: pójdę is written with ó.
Not a word: the ending is -ę without i.
